name: free-for-dev-intelligence
description: Evidence-aware free-tier discovery, comparison, cost, risk, architecture, migration, and change analysis backed by free-for.dev.

interface.shortDescription: Find, verify and compare developer free tiers
interface.longDescription: Search the free-for.dev catalog, normalize evidence, compare services under hard constraints, model quota and cost headroom, audit risk, design architectures, plan migrations, detect changes, and export results.
defaultPrompt: Find production-suitable PostgreSQL free tiers without a required credit card and identify facts that still need provider verification.
Compare these free-tier services for EU use, billing safety, portability, and expected workload.
Design a low-cost developer stack and show which free-tier limits are closest to exhaustion.
